title: Reading Drill — Surveying green roofs after storms — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Surveying green roofs after storms — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The roof inspector in Brackenton received an old report about drains on planted roofs filling with loose material. The report compared clearing time, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the inspection logs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered eight weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include the steepness of each roof. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed mesh guards at runoff points as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
